name: violins
description: Violin section: eight bowed strings with their own violin bodies, tuning, vibrato and timing, spread left of centre; notes that touch are bowed connected.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch sets the length of every player's string; each player is off by a few cents of its own and drifts slowly, and the vibrato runs through a connected line. Per-note pitch bends every string. Held notes play within 3 cents of pitch once settled.
guidance.notes: Notes that touch on a track are connected: `slur = true` keeps the bow and only the finger moves, `slide` slides into the note, and a rest lifts the bow. Velocity and pressure set how fast and hard the bow moves: velocity gives 3/5 of `dynamics` and pressure 2/5, so a pressure curve is a swell. Speed and force rise together, so the tone changes little and the level follows. A stroke after a rest speaks over `attack`; a short `attack` makes a short, accented stroke. The section reads its line half a second ahead. In tune from G3 to B6; above B6 the model's string can leave its normal motion. The default level puts four bars of a slurred violin melody at velocity 0.7 at -20 LUFS.

name: violas
description: Viola section: three bowed strings to a line, so a three-note chord is a divided section of nine, with viola bodies and a narrower vibrato.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch sets the length of every player's string; each player is off by a few cents of its own and drifts slowly, and the vibrato runs through a connected line. Per-note pitch bends every string. Held notes play within 3 cents of pitch once settled.
guidance.notes: Notes that touch on a track are connected: `slur = true` keeps the bow and only the finger moves, `slide` slides into the note, and a rest lifts the bow. Velocity and pressure set how fast and hard the bow moves: velocity gives 3/5 of `dynamics` and pressure 2/5, so a pressure curve is a swell. Speed and force rise together, so the tone changes little and the level follows. A stroke after a rest speaks over `attack`; a short `attack` makes a short, accented stroke. The section reads its line half a second ahead. Chord members join member by member, so close chords are bowed as divided lines. The default level puts four bars of held three-note chords at velocity 0.7 at -20 LUFS.

name: cellos
description: Cello section: five bowed strings with cello bodies, bowed a little nearer the bridge so low strings speak steadily.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch sets the length of every player's string; each player is off by a few cents of its own and drifts slowly, and the vibrato runs through a connected line. Per-note pitch bends every string. Held notes play within 3 cents of pitch once settled.
guidance.notes: Notes that touch on a track are connected: `slur = true` keeps the bow and only the finger moves, `slide` slides into the note, and a rest lifts the bow. Velocity and pressure set how fast and hard the bow moves: velocity gives 3/5 of `dynamics` and pressure 2/5, so a pressure curve is a swell. Speed and force rise together, so the tone changes little and the level follows. A stroke after a rest speaks over `attack`; a short `attack` makes a short, accented stroke. The section reads its line half a second ahead. A soft bow on the lowest notes wavers by a few cents in its first second. The default level puts four whole notes at velocity 0.7 at -20 LUFS.

name: basses
description: Double bass section: three bowed strings with bass bodies and a slow, narrow vibrato.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch sets the length of every player's string; each player is off by a few cents of its own and drifts slowly, and the vibrato runs through a connected line. Per-note pitch bends every string. Held notes play within 3 cents of pitch once settled.
guidance.notes: Notes that touch on a track are connected: `slur = true` keeps the bow and only the finger moves, `slide` slides into the note, and a rest lifts the bow. Velocity and pressure set how fast and hard the bow moves: velocity gives 3/5 of `dynamics` and pressure 2/5, so a pressure curve is a swell. Speed and force rise together, so the tone changes little and the level follows. A stroke after a rest speaks over `attack`; a short `attack` makes a short, accented stroke. The section reads its line half a second ahead. At the loudest dynamics a few of the lowest notes can leave their normal motion for part of a stroke; keep velocity and pressure below about 0.9 there. The default level puts four whole notes at velocity 0.7 at -20 LUFS.

name: concert_harp
description: Concert harp: a soft fingertip pulse into 24 unstretched string modes plucked near the middle, with a faint snap; notes ring for seconds.

guidance.pitch_behavior: Note pitch sets the string's modes, which are harmonic, and its ring, which shortens by 1.5 s per octave; higher notes are slightly louder. Per-note pitch bends the modes.
guidance.notes: Below C2 its level, which falls with pitch, runs out. Notes ring for seconds after their release: give it enough voices for sweeping arpeggios, about 48. Harder notes are brighter. The default level puts four bars of eighth-note arpeggios at velocity 0.7 at -20 LUFS.
